EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

BY virtue of powers vested in me by Section 25A of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, I, Lakshman Kiriella, theMinister of Higher Education and Highways, having obtained a report under Section 70C of the aforesaid Act, in respectof the South Asian Institute of Technology and Medicine Ltd, a company incorporated in Sri Lanka under the CompaniesAct, No. 7 of 2007 and bearing registration number PV 64641, do by this Order, amend the Schedule to the Order madeunder the said Act, and published in Gazatte Extraordinary, No. 1960/4 of March 28, 2016 by the addition immediatelyafter the entry “Bachelor of Science in Engineering in Civil Engineering” appearing in Column I and it’s correspondingentry in Column II thereof, of the entries specified under Column I and Column II respectively of the Schedule II hereto,subject to the conditions specified in Schedule I hereto :-

South Asian Institute of Technology and Medicine Ltd shall, when admitting students for the degree programmespecified in Schedule II hereto in respect of the Bachelor of Science Honours Bio Systems, adhere to the minimum entryqualifications of three (03) ‘S’ passes in the Bio Science stream or Bio System Technology stream in one and the samesitting at the GCE Advanced Level Examination or equivalent.
Bachelor of Science Honours in Bio SystemsBScHons (Bio Systems)
LAKSHMAN KIRIELLA,Minister of Higher Education and Highways.Colombo,28th November 2017.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 25A of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, I, Lakshman Kiriella, theMinister of Higher Education and Highways, having obtained a report under Section 70C of the aforesaid Act, in respectof the Colombo International Nautical and Engineering College (Private) Limited, a company incorporated in Sri Lankaunder the Companies Act, No. 7 of 2007 and bearing registration number PV 17745, do by this Order, amend the Scheduleto the Order made under said Act, and published in Gazatte Extraordinary, No. 1979/21 of August 09, 2016 by theaddition immediately after the entry “Bachelor of Artis in English” appearing in Column I and it’s corresponding entry inColumn II thereof, of the entries specified under Column I and Column II respectively of the Schedule II hereto, subjectto the conditions specified in Schedule I hereto :-

Colombo International Nautical and Engineering College (Private) Limited, shall, when admitting students for the degreeprogramme specified in Schedule II hereto in respect of the Bachelor of Management (Honours) in Retail Marketing andBranding, and Bachelor of Management (Honours) in Supply Chain Management, adhere to the minimum entry qualificationsof three (03) ‘S’ passes in any subject stream in one and the same sitting at the GCE Advanced Level Examination orequivalent.
Bachelor of Management Honours in RetailBMgtHons (Retail Marketing and Branding)Marketing and Branding
Bachelor of Management Honours in SupplyBMgtHons (Supply Chain Management)Chain Management
LAKSHMAN KIRIELLA,Minister of Higher Education and Highways.Colombo,28th November 2017.
